items.source: If a particular factory implementation cannot be loaded due to a LinkageError or ClassNotFoundException, a DEBUG message will be logged, but the associated exception will not be rethrown. A RuntimeException or any other Error will be rethrown. Any other exception will be thrown wrapped in an IllegalStateException.
items.translation: 如果由于 `LinkageError` 或 `ClassNotFoundException` 而无法加载某个特定的工厂实现，将记录一条 `DEBUG` 消息，但不会重新抛出关联的异常。`RuntimeException` 或任何其他 `Error` 将被重新抛出。任何其他异常将被包装在 `IllegalStateException` 中抛出。

items.source: This method utilizes a custom SpringFactoriesLoader.FailureHandler and DEBUG/TRACE logging that are specific to the needs of the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 此方法利用自定义的SpringFactoriesLoader.FailureHandler以及针对Spring TestContext Framework需求特定的 DEBUG/TRACE 日志记录。

items.source: Specifically, this method looks up and instantiates all factoryType entries configured in all META-INF/spring.factories files on the classpath.
items.translation: 具体来说，此方法会查找并实例化类路径上所有 `META-INF/spring.factories` 文件中配置的 `factoryType` 条目。

items.source: Primarily intended for use within the TestContext framework.
items.translation: 主要用于在 TestContext 框架内使用。

items.source: Load factory implementations of the given type via the SpringFactoriesLoader mechanism.
items.translation: 通过 `SpringFactoriesLoader` 机制加载给定类型的工厂实现。

items.source: an unmodifiable list of factory implementations
items.translation: 一个不可修改的工厂实现列表

items.source: factoryType - the interface or abstract class representing the factory
items.translation: factoryType - 代表工厂的接口或抽象类
